title: Healthy-diet affordability and regional food-security disparities
discussion_signal: The post presents healthy-diet affordability as a food-system and household-access problem, linking regional disparities, value chains, prices, and policy rather than treating food supply alone as the solution.
linked_research_question: How do food-system costs and household purchasing room constrain healthy eating despite aggregate food availability?
limits: Post summarizes the SOFI report and does not reproduce its methods
Global aggregates hide household and regional heterogeneity
Affordability is not identical to actual diet or nutrition outcomes
